job.title: Nurse Practitioner
job.description:
Nurse Practitioner - Medicinal Cannabis | Cairns

Applicants from across Australia who are willing to relocate to Cairns are welcome to apply.

Surematch Recruitment is seeking a Nurse Practitioner to join an alternative medical centre in Cairns, Far North Queensland, providing medicinal cannabis consultations and ongoing patient care.
This opportunity would suit a compassionate practitioner with strong clinical assessment skills, sound prescribing judgement and an interest in individualised patient care.

About the role

  • Conduct comprehensive consultations, reviewing medical histories, symptoms and previous treatments.
  • Assess suitability for medicinal cannabis treatment, including contraindications and medication interactions.
  • Develop individualised treatment plans and prescribe where clinically appropriate and authorised.
  • Educate patients about treatment options, potential benefits, risks and monitoring requirements.
  • Provide follow-up consultations to monitor treatment effectiveness and side effects.
  • Maintain accurate clinical records and meet relevant prescribing requirements.
  • Collaborate with other healthcare professionals to support coordinated care.

About you

  • Current AHPRA registration with endorsement as a Nurse Practitioner.
  • Strong clinical assessment, reasoning and medication management skills.
  • Ability to practise autonomously within your professional scope.
  • A compassionate, professional and non-judgemental approach.
  • Excellent communication and patient education skills.
  • Commitment to safe prescribing and ongoing professional development.
  • Medicinal cannabis prescribing experience is highly regarded.
  • Based in Cairns or willing to relocate.

Make the move to Cairns
Looking for a lifestyle change? This is an opportunity to continue your clinical career in tropical Far North Queensland. Local applicants and those considering relocation from anywhere in Australia are encouraged to apply.
Apply now
Send your CV to admin@surematch.com.au or call 1300 319 100 for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Warehouse supervisor
job.description:
Warehouse Supervisor

Help keep a busy warehouse organised and support the team's daily workflow.
Surematch Recruitment is seeking a reliable, hands-on Warehouse Supervisor for our client. This role would suit someone with warehouse experience who enjoys coordinating daily tasks, supporting colleagues and ensuring work is completed accurately.
You'll help oversee warehouse activities from receiving goods through to dispatch, while taking an active role in stock management and product handling. As the items are fragile and require specific care, we're looking for someone who is thorough, organised and attentive to detail.
Your responsibilities will include:

  • Coordinating daily warehouse tasks and supporting the team.
  • Receiving, checking and storing incoming stock.
  • Maintaining accurate stock records and assisting with stocktakes.
  • Checking orders and ensuring items are carefully packed and dispatched.
  • Monitoring product handling and helping maintain quality standards.
  • Learning to operate the pad printer and completing printing tasks.
  • Reporting stock discrepancies and operational issues.
  • Keeping the warehouse safe, clean and organised.

We're looking for someone with:

  • Previous warehouse experience, ideally with some team coordination or supervisory responsibilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and a careful approach to fragile products.
  • Good organisation and time management skills.
  • The ability to work efficiently and help others stay on track.
  • A friendly, bubbly, positive attitude and clear communication skills.
  • Reliability and a willingness to learn.

Approximately one month of training will be provided in the products, handling requirements and pad printing process. Candidates who live locally are encouraged to apply.
To apply: Send your CV to admin@surematch.com.au or call 1300 319 100.

job.title: Warehouse Manager
job.description:
Warehouse Manager

Lead warehouse operations with a focus on organisation, accuracy and care.
Surematch Recruitment is seeking a hands-on Warehouse Manager for our client. This role would suit an experienced warehouse professional who enjoys taking ownership, supporting a team and keeping operations running smoothly.
You'll oversee warehouse operations from end to end, including stock management, goods receiving, storage, order preparation and dispatch. The products are fragile and have specific handling requirements, so attention to detail and a careful, organised approach are essential.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing daily warehouse operations and coordinating workloads.
  • Maintaining accurate stock records and overseeing stocktakes.
  • Ensuring products are received, stored, packed and dispatched carefully.
  • Leading and supporting the team to meet quality and efficiency expectations.
  • Identifying practical improvements to warehouse processes.
  • Learning to operate the pad printer and overseeing product printing requirements.
  • Maintaining a safe, tidy and organised workplace.

We're looking for someone with:

  • Experience in warehouse management or a similar leadership role.
  • Strong stock management, planning and organisational skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling fragile items.
  • A hands-on approach and the ability to take responsibility.
  • Clear communication skills and a friendly, bubbly, positive attitude.
  • Reliability, efficiency and a willingness to learn new products and processes.

Approximately one month of training will be provided to help you learn the products, handling requirements and pad printing process. Candidates who live locally are encouraged to apply.
To apply: Send your CV to admin@surematch.com.au or call 1300 319 100.

job.title: Scaffolder
job.description:
Scaffolders – Cairns | ASAP Start | Ongoing Work

Surematch Recruitment is seeking scaffolders to join a team on a large construction site in Cairns. Immediate starts are available, with ongoing work for the right people.
You’ll assist with site preparation, moving and handling materials, and erecting and dismantling scaffolding within the scope of your qualifications. We’re looking for reliable people who work safely, follow instructions and contribute to the team from day one.
To be considered, you’ll need:

  • A current Basic Scaffolding qualification, relevant High Risk Work Licence or experience in Scaffolding
  • A current White Card
  • Availability to start ASAP
  • Experience working safely on construction sites
  • A reliable approach and willingness to work as part of a team

A driver’s licence is preferred but not essential.
What’s on offer:

  • An ASAP start on a large Cairns construction site
  • Ongoing work opportunities for reliable, suitable candidates
  • Pay rate - Up to $50

Apply now: Send your CV and copies of your scaffolding qualification, High Risk Work Licence and White Card to admin@surematch.com.au, or call 1300 319 100 for more information.
